FeECSs with layered microgaps can be applied to the measurement of soft media, but that the insulation properties of the PZTs need to be improved for long-term use.
the electret condenser sensor is a promising candidate for the measurement of soft materials.
the FeECS with BN agglomerates in the gap has the potential to be an alternative to a piezoelectric sensor for the measurement of soft media.

the FeECSs are promising candidates for ultrasonic probes of soft media, such as natural rubbers.
